ask: How did my posts do over the last 30 days?

steps.why: The brand's timezone, to work out today's date there, so the post window can end now, like the account numbers do.
What went out, with numbers, over the same 30 days counted back from now. Zeros on posts under about a week old mean not synced yet: leave them out of rankings.
Account numbers by network over the same 30 days. engagement here is what posts published in the window earned; never mix it up with one post's results.

say: Acme, last 30 days: 14 posts went out, 12 on LinkedIn and 2 on X. Your two best on LinkedIn were both customer stories. 3 posts from this week aren't synced yet, so they're left out. Want next week's drafts to lean that way?
never: Two reads over different windows, such as a calendar month for posts and 30 days to now for accounts, without saying they differ.
Comparing networks with fewer than 5 posts.
